Can you send a simple MAP and a day-0 checklist (SSO, whitelists, test dataset, load profile) we can present to the internal stakeholders on Friday? Procurement will also need the contract milestone for invoicing.

Forwarded/Context: Harborline asked about go-live cadence and test windows; high-level target: pilot by 2027-01-25, production in Q1 2027.
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@harborline.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + day-0 checklist request

Emma — thanks for the note. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a Day-0 checklist PDF for Friday's stakeholder meeting. High-level summary below, full details in the workbook (attached).

Quick summary (draft):
- M1: Contract signature (Procurement) — target 2026-12-15 — owner: Harborline procurement / Redwood sales (Aditya)
- M2: SSO & network allowlist completed — target 2026-12-22 — owner: Harborline IT / Redwood infra (Dylan)
- M3: Pilot dataset and evals run — target 2027-01-10 — owner: Harborline PM / Redwood ML Eng (Aditya)
- M4: Pilot go/no-go review — target 2027-01-18 — owner: Harborline Execs + Redwood CS (Monica)
- M5: Production cutover window — target 2027-02-07 to 2027-02-09 — owner: Harborline SRE + Redwood Ops (Monica/Dylan)

Day-0 checklist highlights:
- Provide SAML metadata + IdP test account
- Open outbound allowlist (10.11.0.0/16) and API IPs (we list in sheet)
- Deliver sample dataset (anonymized) and expected traffic profile
- Confirm telemetry & logging retention (30d default, options to extend)

Attachments (stubs): Draft_MAP_Harborline_v0.1.xlsx, Harborline_Day0_Checklist.pdf

Next steps: Aditya will own the contract milestone and pricing line; Monica will lead the CS handoff and run the pilot cadence. Can the procurement contact confirm 12/15 availability for signature?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@harborline.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + day-0 checklist request

Emma / Dylan — adding the technical milestones and owner roster from our infra side. I updated the workbook tab 'Technical Milestones' with concrete tasks and estimated effort. Highlights: 

Technical milestones (ops/engineering):
- Network & SSO tests: 3 business days (owner: Harborline IT / Redwood Infra) — target completion 2026-12-22
- Staging capacity sizing & reserved nodes: provisioning request by 2026-12-20, capacity live 2026-12-28
- Model onboarding (quantized variant for pilot): model file exchange by 2027-01-03, validation by 2027-01-07
- End-to-end load test: target 2027-01-12 (window: 2 hours) — Redwood will provide load harness and synthetic traffic profile

I've also added a 'fallback' policy row: if procurement delays push signature past 12/20, we shift pilot to late Jan and open a grace window for burst capacity.

Attachments: updated workbook (same filename)

Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@harborline.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:49:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + day-0 checklist request

Emma — hi. I'm Monica from CS and I'll be your primary contact for pilot enablement and the handoff after contract sign. A few operational notes and the proposed Handoff & RACI: 

Handoff plan (post-signature):
- Week 0 (first 7 days after signature): Kickoff meeting + technical onboarding (Monica + Dylan)
- Week 1-2: SSO verification, allowlist validation, staging provisioning (Harborline IT / Redwood Infra)
- Week 3-4: Pilot configuration, eval runs, checkpoints with Harborline PM
- Week 6: Pilot review & success criteria sign-off — if success, schedule production cutover window

RACI (summary):
- Contract sign (Procurement) — R: Procurement; A: Harborline Execs; C: Aditya; I: Monica
- SSO & network (IT) — R: Harborline IT; A: Harborline IT; C: Dylan; I: Monica
- Pilot evaluation (PM) — R: Harborline PM; A: Harborline Execs; C: Redwood ML Eng; I: Monica

Immediate asks for Day-0:
1) Procurement confirm target 12/15 for signature (or share alternative date)
2) IT to share SAML metadata and a test IdP account before 12/18
3) PM to upload anonymized sample dataset to the shared drive (see link)

Emma — can you confirm those three items by EOD Wednesday? I can also schedule the kick-off meeting for 12/16 if procurement confirms 12/15.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@harborline.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + day-0 checklist request

All — quick update from Harborline: Procurement confirmed internal legal review and are targeting signature on 2026-12-16 (one day later than proposed). IT will share SAML metadata by 2026-12-17 and we will upload a sanitized sample dataset to the shared drive by 2026-12-18.

We reviewed the draft MAP and Day-0 checklist and it looks good overall. A few micro-asks (I listed in the Drive doc):
- Can Redwood provide template IdP metadata for our SSO engineer to validate attributes?
- Please confirm the IPs we will need to allow for staging + pilot.
- Add a short acceptance criteria row for pilot (latency P95 < 350ms, throughput 120 requests/min sustained during load test).

Next actions per Harborline:
- Procurement: signature 2026-12-16
- IT: SAML metadata 2026-12-17, dataset upload 2026-12-18
- Redwood: provide IdP template & final MAP by 2026-12-09 EOD (Dylan / Aditya to own)

Thanks,
Emma

---
Summary: Monica to schedule kickoff for week of 12/20 if signature completes 12/16; Redwood team to deliver final MAP workbook and IdP template by 12/09 EOD.
